text: Alison Parker, a fashion model with past suicide attempts, [moves into a Brooklyn Heights brownstone|trigger|making a new home] where a blind priest, Father Halliran, sits all day at the top floor window. She faints, cannot sleep, meets odd neighbours and attends a birthday party for an old man's cat, then learns the building holds only the priest and her. Her dead father walks the halls, the partygoers prove to be [long-dead murderers|images|ghosts and strange figures], and the house turns out to be [a gateway to Hell|threat|evil places] waiting for [its next guardian|ending|the evil is handed on].
